changes: Preserve scoped service-principal reads for deadlines/calendar, matter parties/contact matters, firm zone, addresses, roles, custom-field definitions and work-email directory; all module calls remain audited under the module id.

Service principals remain outside every wall: omit records without disclosing omission or membership; gets are not_found. Retain REST/MCP Postgres omission, delegated inside-wall access and next-read recovery after wall lifting.
Preserve matter-party mail under mail:send, own settings reads/admin setup writes and applicable contract runtime settings; modules:write stays forbidden.
Preserve forwarded provider context delegation, targeted/deduplicated contract envelopes and too_large provider-response errors.

All core webhook senders use v1.0.0 t=<unix>,v1=<hex> signatures over timestamp + dot + raw body, with matching X-Togavsu-Timestamp. Add SignTimestampedWebhook; retain every batch 2 public name/signature and SignWebhook output. VerifyWebhook accepts both forms with constant-time HMAC comparison and applicable skew checks; header-aware helper also checks a supplied timestamp.

Pin independent literal vectors for both signature forms; test substitution, expiry/future/window bounds, malformed/mismatched timestamps, empty secrets and tampering. Update API conventions, modules guide, OpenAPI, kit docs and gap rows.
Preserve approved per-hook Authorization opt-in, provider CRC/HMAC helpers, RESTRICT-safe purge, shared timeline/Activities Feed module attribution and delegated person actors.
Preserve Goose Up-only inventory, documented runtime pending criteria with strict retirement, the converter stand-in and contact phone-row item slot.
